test_cases.title: Admin edits an existing group address and the change is saved
acs: DERIVED: Save on a valid Edit Group Address form returns to the Group Addresses list and keeps the change - app/ProficiencyTestingWeb/Contracts Admin/GroupAddress.aspx.vb:56-62 (route /Contracts Admin/GroupAddress.aspx)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin.
Test data: unique value E2E packing note <run id>; <run id> is a unique run identifier such as a timestamp.
Changes data. The final step restores the original Packing Instructions.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/GroupAddressList.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Group Addresses and the table shows the columns Identifier, Address 1 and Edit.

steps.action: Select the Edit link on the first row of the table.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Edit Group Address and the form is filled with the saved values of that group address.

steps.action: Note the current value of Packing Instructions as <original packing instructions> and the Identifier of the record.
steps.expected: The original Packing Instructions value and the Identifier are recorded for later steps.

steps.action: Replace the Packing Instructions value with E2E packing note <run id>.
steps.expected: The Packing Instructions field shows E2E packing note <run id>.

steps.action: Select Save.
steps.expected: The page returns to Group Addresses and the h1 reads Group Addresses.

steps.action: Select Edit on the row with the same Identifier.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Edit Group Address and Packing Instructions shows E2E packing note <run id>.

steps.action: Cleanup: replace the Packing Instructions value with <original packing instructions> and select Save.
steps.expected: The page returns to Group Addresses and the record holds its original Packing Instructions again.

test_cases.title: Admin cancels an edit of a group address and nothing changes
acs: DERIVED: Cancel on Edit Group Address leaves the page without saving - app/ProficiencyTestingWeb/Contracts Admin/GroupAddress.aspx (route /Contracts Admin/GroupAddress.aspx; Cancel behaviour observed in the crawl, destination TODO)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin.
Test data: unique value E2E cancelled note <run id>.
Nothing is saved, so no data cleanup is needed. The cancel destination is not confirmed (see open_questions).

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/GroupAddressList.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Group Addresses.

steps.action: Select the Edit link on the first row of the table.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Edit Group Address.

steps.action: Note the current value of Packing Instructions as <original packing instructions> and the Identifier of the record.
steps.expected: The original value and the Identifier are recorded.

steps.action: Replace the Packing Instructions value with E2E cancelled note <run id>.
steps.expected: The Packing Instructions field shows E2E cancelled note <run id>.

steps.action: Select Cancel.

steps.action: Open the Edit link for the row with the same Identifier on Group Addresses.

steps.action: Cleanup: select Cancel to leave the form.
steps.expected: The form closes and no data has been changed.

test_cases.title: Required fields block saving a new group address
acs: DERIVED: Saving an empty Create Group Address form shows the four required validations (Identifier, Address 1, Address 2, Country) and stays on the page - app/ProficiencyTestingWeb/Contracts Admin/GroupAddress.aspx:1-52 (route /Contracts Admin/GroupAddress.aspx)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin.
The validation messages are shown as an image whose alt text starts: An identifier m..., At least two Ad..., The Country for...; the full text is not recorded.
Nothing is saved, so no data cleanup is needed.

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/GroupAddressList.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Group Addresses.

steps.action: Select the Create Group Address link.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Create Group Address and every field is empty.

steps.action: Leave every field empty and select Save.
steps.expected: The page stays on Create Group Address and no server error page is shown.

steps.action: Look at the validation next to Identifier.
steps.expected: A validation marker whose text starts An identifier m is shown.

steps.action: Look at the validation next to Address 1 and Address 2.
steps.expected: A validation marker whose text starts At least two Ad is shown for Address 1 and for Address 2.

steps.action: Look at the validation next to Country.
steps.expected: A validation marker whose text starts The Country for is shown.

steps.action: Cleanup: select Cancel and open the Group Addresses list.
steps.expected: The list shows no new row, because nothing was saved.

test_cases.title: Admin creates a new group address and it is listed
acs: DERIVED: Save on a valid Create Group Address form returns to the Group Addresses list, which then lists the new identifier - app/ProficiencyTestingWeb/Contracts Admin/GroupAddress.aspx.vb:56-62 (route /Contracts Admin/GroupAddressList.aspx)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin.
Test data: Identifier E2E-<run id>; Address 1 1 Test Street; Address 2 Testtown; Country <any listed country>.
NOT repeatable without a reset: the UI has no Delete, so the created record cannot be removed from the UI. Cleanup needs a database reset (see open_questions).

steps.action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/GroupAddressList.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Group Addresses.

steps.action: Select the Create Group Address link.
steps.expected: The h1 reads Create Group Address.

steps.action: Enter E2E-<run id> in Identifier, 1 Test Street in Address 1 and Testtown in Address 2.
steps.expected: The three fields show the entered values.

steps.action: Choose <any listed country> in Country.
steps.expected: The Country field shows the chosen country.

steps.action: Select Save.
steps.expected: The page returns to Group Addresses and the h1 reads Group Addresses.

steps.action: Look for the identifier E2E-<run id> in the table.
steps.expected: A row with Identifier E2E-<run id> and Address 1 1 Test Street is listed.

steps.action: Cleanup: ask the environment owner to reset the database, because the UI offers no Delete.
steps.expected: The group address E2E-<run id> is no longer present after the reset.
